About StudioSpace

StudioSpace is a peer-to-peer marketplace built for creators, filmmakers, photographers, podcasters, and musicians. We connect studio owners with the people who need professional creative environments — from cyclorama walls and cinema sound stages to intimate podcast lounges and music recording suites.

Our mission is simple: make high-quality production spaces accessible, transparent, and easy to book. Hosts list their spaces with clear hourly rates and amenities; creators discover, filter, and reserve slots with real-time availability and protected booking flows.

Whether you are shooting a commercial, recording a podcast episode, or hosting an art workshop, StudioSpace gives you the tools to find the right room and get creating faster.

For Hosts

Monetize underused space, set your own rates, and welcome verified creators. Liability guidelines, equipment safety tips, and 24/7 support help you host with confidence.

For Creators

Browse by category, compare amenities, and book instantly. Transparent pricing and double-booking prevention mean fewer surprises and more time on set.
